children.value: > Fact From Story: “The board no longer has confidence in his ability to continue leading OpenAI,” the artificial intelligence company said in a statement.
> > Fact From Story: The statement said his behavior was hindering the board’s ability to exercise its responsibilities.
> > > Fact From Story: OpenAI declined to answer questions on what Altman’s alleged lack of candor was about.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A lack of candor can hinder the board's ability to exercise its responsibilities.
> > Fact From Story: OpenAI declined to answer questions on what Altman’s alleged lack of candor was about.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: When a board loses confidence in a CEO's ability to lead, it's because they believe the CEO is not fulfilling their responsibilities.

> Fact From Story: ChatGPT-maker Open AI said Friday it has pushed out its co-founder and CEO Sam Altman after a review found he was “not consistently candid in his communications” with the board of directors.

> > Fact From Story: The announcement also said another OpenAI co-founder and top executive, Greg Brockman, the board’s chairman, would step down from that role but remain at the company, where he serves as president.

> > > Fact From Story: In another X post on Friday night, Brockman said Altman was asked to join a video meeting at noon Friday with the company’s board members, minus Brockman, during which OpenAI co-founder and Chief Scientist Ilya Sutskever informed Altman he was being fired.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Being fired means you are no longer CEO of the company.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: When a CEO is ousted, top executives and board members may also leave or be demoted.
> Commonsense Knowledge: When a CEO is pushed out of a company and the board states they no longer have confidence in his ability to lead, it means the CEO has been ousted.
